chunks: Have they not realized that anyone who opposes God and His Prophet, will abide in Hell for ever? And that is the worst disgrace.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of opposing God and His Prophet according to Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Muhadadat* (rivalry) against divine authority, particularly emphasizing the Prophet's unique status as the ultimate interpreter of revelation. It underscores the eternal nature of the punishment for those who actively contest Allah's will through His Messenger, a theme central to understanding the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt in subsequent theological developments.
